rating.verdict: A fun, flavorful Orzhov flyers deck built mostly from Bloomburrow's Bat cards plus Owlin. It's good at a casual Modern night, but the creatures are Standard-level and well behind Modern's top decks.
strengths: Every life gain or loss triggers drains, counters or pumps
Pain lands, fetches and shocks turn your own life loss into an advantage
weaknesses: Small creatures die to cheap sweepers and burn
Low raw card quality for Modern
Few ways to come back once behind

wins: Fly over with Bats and Owls. Every time you gain or lose life your creatures grow, gain deathtouch or drain the opponent, so the damage adds up from the air.
plan: Ruin-Lurker Bat, or a pain land / fetch so Essence Channeler flies later.
Starscape Cleric, Lifecreed Duo, Essence Channeler, Moonrise Cleric. Fatal Push anything that blocks in the air.
Zoraline and Moonstone Harbinger: attack with every Bat, gain life and make the team deathtouch.
Starseer Mentor taxes the opponent every end step; Owlin Shieldmage is a hard-to-target closer.
keys: Each attacking Bat gains you life, and she can bring back a dead 3-drop for {W}{B} and 2 life.
Each time you gain life, each opponent loses 1. With Moonrise Cleric and Ruin-Lurker Bat that is a drain every combat.
Gaining or losing life on your turn gives all your Bats +1/+0 and deathtouch.
If your life changed this turn, the opponent loses 3 or gives up a card or permanent every end step.
3/3 flyer with ward: pay 3 life, so removal costs the opponent.
tips: Caves of Koilos, Silent Clearing, Marsh Flats and shock lands make you lose life: that alone turns on Essence Channeler's flying, Moonstone Harbinger and Starseer Mentor.
Starscape Cleric can't block; keep it attacking.
Offspring: pay the extra cost on Starscape Cleric ({2}{B}) to also get a 1/1 copy that drains too.
Owlin Historian gets +1/+1 whenever cards leave your graveyard, like Zoraline's return.
Kaya's Guile: pick two modes; edict plus 4 life is a strong default, graveyard exile in the sideboard games.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with both colors (or a fetch / Caves) and at least two creatures that cost 1–2.
